profile.org_note: Founder-led, builder-owned private company run from one Fort Myers office: a four-person executive team (CEO, CFO, EVP revenue and strategy, EVP homebuilding operations) over three Florida regions, only one of which (East Central) has a named division president. Land decisions sit with EVP Kristine Smale (the former VP of land acquisition and development) and Director of Land Acquisition Maurice French; finance with EVP & CFO Candy Kane and the controller.
profile.summary: Private, founder-owned Florida builder of entry-level concrete-block single-family homes, founded 2017 and based in Fort Myers (not Punta Gorda); 554 to 555 closings in 2025 and No. 93 on the 2026 Builder 100 per its own releases. Almost all of its volume is on scattered infill ('spot') lots in pre-platted communities such as Cape Coral, Lehigh Acres, Port Charlotte, Palm Bay, Citrus Springs and Marion Oaks, plus a build-on-your-lot programme; it is now moving into master plans (Brightshore in Naples) and new West Central Florida markets. A conventional for-sale builder, but its scattered-lot model means land-bank demand would come mainly from its newer community positions.
